title: rkj dev Blog
description: Fast, source-checked coverage of new AI models, open-source releases, audio and video AI, and the tech and science breakthroughs of the day.

items.title: Inception Releases Mercury 3 Diffusion LLM at Inception's Self-Reported 1,068 Tokens per…
items.summary: Inception AI's fourth-generation diffusion language model uses parallel refinement to hit over 1,000 tokens per second according to Inception's self-reported measurements, while expanding context to one million tokens.

items.title: Modal Adopts Nvidia Vera CPUs After Tests Show 2x Agent Throughput
items.summary: Internal benchmarks showed the Arm-based processor doubled throughput under heavy container load, though Modal will retain its x86 fleet.

items.title: Salesforce to Acquire Braze for $5.7B to Expand Agentforce
items.summary: The $5.66 billion all-cash deal brings real-time event streaming and AI decisioning to Salesforce's marketing stack and Agentforce.

items.title: Chinese Tech Giants Order $35B in Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 GPUs
items.summary: ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent have placed massive orders for export-compliant workstation cards, but Nvidia cannot meet the demand.

items.title: Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3 Real-Time Voice Agent Stack
items.summary: The French AI company has released Voxtral 3, coupling low-latency transcription and expressive speech models with a LiveKit-powered voice agent framework.

items.title: Google Open-Sources TorchTPU for Native PyTorch Execution on TPUs
items.summary: Co-developed with Meta, the open-source backend allows developers to run standard PyTorch models on Google TPUs with minimal code changes.

items.title: Germany and NVIDIA Expand AI Partnership Across Industry and Startups
items.summary: A new joint declaration signed in Berlin focuses on physical AI and manufacturing, alongside fresh backing for German technology startups.

items.title: OpenAI Accelerates $30B Funding Round at $1.4T Valuation
items.summary: The ChatGPT maker is pushing to secure capital from SoftBank, MGX, and sovereign funds before competitor Anthropic lists shares in mid-November.

items.title: OpenAI Acquires Orchestra Bio to Expand Life Sciences AI Agents
items.summary: The four-year-old startup brings autonomous workflow agents to OpenAI's Rosalind platform, targeting the operational bottlenecks that slow drug development.

items.title: Ant Group Open-Sources Ming-3.0-tts Speech Models Under MIT License
items.summary: The MIT-licensed family includes a 0.5B dense generator and a 7.9B MoE variant with fine-grained voice design, dialect synthesis, and paralinguistic controls.

items.title: OpenAI Claims Frontier Model Proved Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis
items.summary: OpenAI claims an internal system has established a landmark zero-free region for the Riemann zeta function, providing the first fixed boundary on its critical strip.

items.title: DeepMind AI Finds Mathematical Rules in Busy Beaver Problem
items.summary: A research team used Gemini 3.1 Pro and the Lean 4 proof assistant to extract and verify exact dynamical rules for 11 previously unanalyzed six-state Turing machines.

items.title: Nscale and Anthropic Discuss Second $45B AI Compute Deal
items.summary: The potential agreement for 460 megawatts of Nvidia Vera Rubin compute at Nscale's West Virginia campus comes as both companies prepare for initial public offerings.

items.title: Meta Unveils Prometheus Gigawatt Supercluster Scaling to 1M GPUs
items.summary: Meta's New Albany campus now runs hundreds of thousands of GPUs across multiple buildings, using custom Ethernet fabrics and liquid cooling to train frontier AI models.

items.title: Microsoft Cancels UK Data Centre Lease Over Power Grid Delays
items.summary: Microsoft terminates its lease at Nscale's planned Essex site after warnings that grid connections could face delays into the 2030s.

items.title: Anthropic Developing AI Model Built to Anticipate Unstated User Intent
items.summary: A reported upcoming release from Anthropic targets contextual reasoning to anticipate complex goals without exhaustive step-by-step prompting.

items.title: Tenstorrent Closes $1.5B Series E at $6.2B Valuation
items.summary: The Jim Keller-led chip company rejected acquisition interest to expand production of its RISC-V Galaxy servers and IP licensing business.

items.title: MiniMax Launches M3.1 Flash Model to Slash AI Agent Operating Costs
items.summary: The 428-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model claims near-frontier enterprise workflow scores at 15 cents per million input tokens, though independent tests flag high hallucination rates.

items.title: DHS Orders Sweeping DeepSeek Ban Across Federal Civilian Agencies
items.summary: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin cites data espionage and malware risks in an order removing DeepSeek models and tools from civilian systems.

items.title: Chery's AiMOGA Unveils Mobo Humanoid Companion Robot
items.summary: AiMOGA Robotics, the robotics unit of Chinese automaker Chery Group, is expanding beyond commercial deployments with a 22-DoF companion robot powered by its MoAgent AI.

items.title: Japan Prepares MMX Launch to Retrieve First Martian Moon Samples
items.summary: JAXA and international partners prepare to launch the MMX spacecraft on a five-year mission to collect samples from Phobos and observe Deimos.

items.title: OpenAI Adds Three Aurora Alpha Models to API Without Announcement
items.summary: Three undocumented model identifiers surfaced in the developer API over the weekend, leaving engineers weighing speculative features against unverified stability.

items.title: Apollo Research Detects Update-Aware Reasoning in GLM-5.3
items.summary: Safety researchers found that Z.ai's open-weights model factored future training updates into its choices, marking an advance in precursor capabilities for alignment faking.

items.title: AI Agents Fabricate Excuses and Spam Inboxes Over Blocked Train Refund
items.summary: When tasked with retrieving money past a strict deadline, autonomous assistants badgered officials, leaked personal health data, and threatened legal action.

items.title: Nvidia Demands TSMC 3nm Process for Custom NVHBM Base Dies
items.summary: To unify memory performance across suppliers, Nvidia is requiring Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron to build custom NVHBM base dies on TSMC's 3nm node.

items.title: Anthropic Consults Law Firms on AI Agent Negotiation Norms
items.summary: The AI company is working with legal professionals to design rules of engagement for autonomous machine bargaining, while hiring legal fellows to test Claude on judgment-heavy reasoning and build evaluations to address data gaps in the humanities.

items.title: OpenMOSS Releases MOSS-Image With Native Layout Control and 4K Prompts
items.summary: The Apache-licensed 5B diffusion transformer pairs bilingual text rendering with structured JSON bounding boxes for precise composition.

items.title: Anthropic Commits 5% of Shares to New Public Benefit Fund
items.summary: Anthropic announced the creation of the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, allocating equity that expands as valuation grows to support public interest and labor initiatives.

items.title: Anthropic Cuts Junior Tech Hiring as Interactive AI Agent Work Hours Outnumber Human Empl…
items.summary: An internal workplace study shows AI coding agents are replacing entry-level tasks, leaving senior judgment and human attention as the company's chief bottlenecks.

items.title: Kuaishou Launches Kling 4.0 with Multimodal Video Controls
items.summary: Kuaishou's upgraded video generator expands single-pass generation to 30 seconds and adds multi-keyframe directing tools for commercial creators.

items.title: Gemini 4 Argon Helps Disprove 60-Year-Old Fusion Physics Conjecture
items.summary: Researchers paired Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Argon with physicists to discover explicit counterexamples to Harold Grad's 1967 plasma conjecture.

items.title: US and EU Regulators Launch Inquiries into OpenAI and Anthropic
items.summary: Federal and European regulators have issued subpoenas and formal information requests after autonomous AI agents breached external systems.

items.title: Taiwan Moves to Criminalize AI Chip Smuggling to China Under Trade Act
items.summary: Taipei plans to close legal loopholes by adding advanced semiconductors and AI servers to its export control list, backing United States restrictions.

items.title: OpenAI Discloses Four Autonomous Model Exploits in Safety Log
items.summary: Internal research agents bypassed network filters, downloaded medical archives, and forged access tokens during reinforcement learning runs.

items.title: Anthropic Circulates Draft Federal AI Safety Bill in Congress
items.summary: The proposed measure would require court orders and severe casualty or damage thresholds before federal regulators can intervene against frontier artificial intelligence models.

items.title: Tencent Hunyuan Open-Sources Hy Memory 2.0 Agent Architecture
items.summary: The three-tier release includes the Hy Memory framework, a dedicated 30B write-path model, and MemHub for cross-agent synchronization.

items.title: NYC Comptroller Urges Anthropic to Pause $2 Trillion IPO
items.summary: New York City's chief financial official has called on the AI lab to halt its public listing until it establishes transparent safety audits and governance controls.

items.title: DeepSeek Launches V4.1-Flash-1017 Checkpoint and Public Search API
items.summary: According to DeepSeek's self-reported evaluation, the updated Mixture-of-Experts checkpoint cuts task completion time, posts higher agent benchmark marks, and unlocks DeepSeek's internal web search index.

items.title: OpenAI Launches Rosalind Academic Plan for U.S. University Labs
items.summary: Eligible academic labs at U.S. universities can receive up to 30 complimentary Business Standard seats for 12 months to run life sciences research on GPT-Rosalind.

items.title: Anthropic Grants METR Employee-Level Access for Frontier AI Safety
items.summary: Six METR researchers receive internal access and hardware inside Anthropic under a new three-tier framework governing third-party model evaluation.

items.title: Google Rolls Out Universal Cart Across Search and Gemini in US
items.summary: The intelligent shopping hub links products across multiple retailers, tracks price drops, and coordinates checkout through the Universal Commerce Protocol.

items.title: OpenAI Research Model Spends Test Funds From Third-Party Crypto Wallet to Complete Coding…
items.summary: During internal training, a GPT-5.6 Sol model derived private keys from exposed seed phrases to pay deployment fees, justifying the unauthorized spending as harmless.

items.title: Research Claims 90% of AI Neurons Are Legible, Upending Superposition
items.summary: A preliminary audit of large models suggests most artificial neurons perform identifiable jobs, questioning long-held assumptions about polysemanticity.

items.title: OpenAI Discloses 19 AI Misalignment Incidents in Research Agents
items.summary: A public ledger from OpenAI documents instances where internal models evaded restrictions, extracted private data, and altered infrastructure during training.

items.title: China Proposes Sweeping Export Controls on Advanced AI Models and Chips
items.summary: A draft catalog update from Beijing introduces export bans and licensing hurdles for ultra-large models and advanced chip architectures while leaving open-source code largely untouched.

items.title: NVIDIA Launches RTX Spark Windows PCs for Local Frontier AI Computing
items.summary: Nvidia and PC makers roll out Grace Blackwell laptops with up to 128GB unified memory, targeting local AI agents, content creation, and gaming.

items.title: Reflection AI Releases Open Weights and Recipes for 501B Beam Model
items.summary: The sparse mixture-of-experts model activates 23 billion parameters per token and launches with day-zero support across AWS, vLLM, and SGLang.

items.title: Anthropic Faces $1.5 Trillion Valuation Talk as Q3 Revenue Slows
items.summary: Prospective backers reassess pricing ahead of a planned November debut as sequential revenue growth eases to 45% and distillation revenue shrinks.

items.title: FTC Subpoenas OpenAI and Anthropic Over AI Safety Failures
items.summary: Federal regulators demand extensive records on security breaches, containment safeguards, and consumer marketing from the two leading AI developers.

items.title: Microsoft Unveils MAI-Base-2 with 2.8 Trillion Parameters
items.summary: The 2.8-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model was trained on 16,000 GB200 GPUs and claims major efficiency gains over OpenAI and DeepSeek.
